title: Property Bridging Finance: A Guide for UK HNWIs
summary: Blog article / guide on property bridging finance for UK high-net-worth individuals. Neither search retrieved the article body: search [a] (exact URL) explicitly reported it could not retrieve the page and fell back to other Silver Oak pages and third-party listings; search [b] (site: query) returned the page as its first result with the title 'Property Bridging Finance: A Guide for UK HNWIs' and attributed two statements to 'the firm's guide': lenders are 'especially flexible for borrowers borrowing over £2,000,000', and bridging is 'short-term funding tied to a property sale, refinance, or other expected cash flow'. That is the full extent of what the results reveal about the article's thesis and guidance. The search summaries additionally surfaced context from other pages: the FAQ (bridge = short-term facility up to 12-24 months for active investors and business owners, repaid within the term), the £3.6m Kensington bridging case study (completed within four weeks, 0.78% per month, BBR-linked), the £1.46m 5-year interest-only Prime Central London refinance (personal guarantee from an overseas HNWI with no UK footprint), and a client-type statement (HNW and UHNW individuals, property developers, family offices and trustees, international clients with UK assets) whose source page is not specified. Article headings, sections, H1, meta description, CTAs, process steps and any article-level FAQ were not revealed.
